title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 90
paragraphs: Meanwhile Nicodromus, since the Athenians had not come to help at the proper time, boarded a ship and escaped from Aegina, and some other Aeginetans went with him. The Athenians gave them Sunion to settle in, and from that base these men continued to plunder the Aeginetans still on the island.
